title: int:Trade
description: A matched and settled energy trade between a buyer and a seller. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument. Mirrors the Rust EwdsTradeDto (camelCase wire form; epoch-integer timestamp).

bidId.description: FK to bid Order. IRI: int:bidId.

buyerId.description: FK to buying Actor. IRI: int:buyerId.

residualBidId.description: FK to residual bid Order. IRI: int:residualBidId. Nullable.

offerId.description: FK to offer Order. IRI: int:offerId.

sellerId.description: FK to selling Actor. IRI: int:sellerId.

residualOfferId.description: FK to residual offer Order. IRI: int:residualOfferId. Nullable.

tradeQuantity.description: Traded energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:tradeQuantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

tradePrice.description: Settled trade price in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:tradePrice. Unit: EUR/kWh.

timestamp.description: Trade time slot / creation timestamp. IRI: int:tradedAt. Unix epoch (seconds).
